name: 笑容加
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=笑容加
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = myusmile.online, wemallh5.usmile.com, www.myusmile.online

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/myusmile\.online\/user\/version\/requestAppUpdate/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/myusmile\.online\/user\/version\/requestFirmwareUpdate\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/wemallh5\.usmile\.com\/api\/sp-portal\/store\/usmile\/activity\/dayCheck\?pop/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.myusmile\.online\/user\/userTagRecord\/popup/i then reject(404)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.myusmile\.online\/user\/plaqueTopic\/selectByType/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/usmile.js") with tag="笑容加-我的页面推广", timeout=60, requires_body=true
